counterfactual_missing_items: Right eye showed corneal stromal haze, 3+ anterior chamber cell (26-50 cells/1 × 1 mm slitlamp field), posterior synechiae, vitreous cell and haze obscuring retinal vascular details, blurred disc margins, and superonasal peripheral retinal whitening
Left eye showed corneal haze, 1-mm hypopyon, posterior synechiae, vitreous cell and haze obscuring retinal vascular details, blurred disc margins, and superotemporal peripheral retinal whitening
decisive_items: Cerebrospinal fluid T pallidum particle agglutination assay: positive
Direct scrapings from skin plaques demonstrate interface dermatitis with spirochetes evident upon hematoxylin-eosin staining
response.rationale: R4 is supported by three raw spans (CSF TPHA, RPR 1:64, and spirochetes on skin biopsy) that definitively establish syphilis. R6 is more specific to the ocular presentation but lacks the skin spirochete raw span and does not cite ocular raw spans, so R4 has stronger raw evidence.

rejected.why: Only HIV labs; no syphilis serology or spirochetes; positive TPHA/RPR and skin spirochetes make HIV retinitis unlikely.
Immunosuppression is a predisposing state, not a diagnosis; does not explain uveitis or syphilis confirmation.
Append-only completion of R4; as supplied it lacks CSF TPHA/RPR raw spans and is not a fixed candidate.
